content:
BUILT CoLAB is organising a meeting of Collaborative Laboratories (CoLABs) and Technology and Innovation Centres (CTIs) with the aim of establishing a platform for joint collaboration, specifically in the areas of digital and sustainable construction.

BUILT CoLAB is organising a meeting of Collaborative Laboratories (CoLABs) and Technology and Innovation Centres (CTIs) with the aim of establishing a platform for joint collaboration, specifically in the areas of digital and sustainable construction.

If you belong to a CoLAB or CTI, we’d be delighted to have you! Register at https://tinyurl.com/encontrocolabsctis by 7th March. In case of doubt or for additional questions, we are available at info@builtcolab.pt.
